messages.content: You identify patterns in complete email texts. Respond with valid JSON.

Please write a BRIEF 15-20 word executive summary of the theme "Information Provision" as it appears in the following examples.
["We're rebooting our SSL server due to recent upgrade on our security to serve you better.", 'Your eBay account is temporarily locked - Confirm your identity', "We wrote to you recently to tell you we're increasing the security which protects Online Banking.", 'You have 1 new secure message', 'Your Account is Suspended, Some information on your account appears to be missing or incorrect.', 'You have received this email because we have strong reason to believe that your PayPal account had been recently compromised.', 'PetroSun Announces Formation of Algae BioFuels', 'Your ad, titled "SONY PlayStation 3 METAL GEAR SOLID 4 PS3 80 GB BUNDLE!", has been posted as follows:<<link>> (electronics)', 'We would like to notify you that NatWest bank carries out customer data verification procedure that is compulsory for all NatWest bank customers.', 'You have one new security message from ANZ Internet Banking', 'We are contacting you to remind you that on August 03, 2010, the Chase Security Department identified some unusual activity involving your Chase Card account.', 'Your account is having some technical problems.', 'We would like to notify you that NatWest bank carries out customer data verification procedure that is compulsory for all NatWest bank customers.', 'This is the final concluding mention to inform you as of 18 - Sep - 2016 that you have not yet updated your iTunes ID details.', 'We detect irregular activity on your Halifax Internet banking account on 11/10/2010.', 'We re-writing to let you know that your online account has been temporarily suspended due to recent access to your account from an unknown IP address.', 'On the 21st of April 1999, my client, his wife and their three children were involved in a car accident along Abuja Express Road.', 'You have received this email because you or someone had used your account from different locations.', "This message is to alert you that you have a new response from customer care in your secure messages' area of your Internet Banking.", 'the profile that you are using to access Abbey Financial Group Online Banking has been locked because of too many failed login attempts.', 'Your two incoming mails were placed on pending status due to the recent upgrade to our database, In order to receive the messages Click Here To Confirm Your Account.', 'Your booking is confirmed.']

Please respond ONLY with a valid JSON in the following format:

    "summary": "<SUMMARY>"
}
